objective: Recover the Book System's parent-owned authoring lifecycle from durable repository evidence without promoting child-project or evaluator-local mechanics to parent authority by assumption.
audited_surfaces: literary-prose-engine-001 current child-project tree and State-009 chain
repository branch inventory for book/writing-named branches
default-branch searches for Book System / Books / story-bible authoring authority
recovery_rule: A capability may be classified RECOVERED_PARENT only when a parent-authoritative Book System contract/state is found. Child-project capability is CHILD_AVAILABLE, evaluator-lane capability is LANE_AVAILABLE, and an expected parent lifecycle function with no parent authority found is PARENT_CONTRACT_MISSING. No category is promoted merely because useful implementation exists elsewhere.

historical_instruction_recovered.finding: The Prose starter required a forensic inventory of existing Books, writing, story-bible, research/evidence, artifact, retrieval/indexing and generation components; it prohibited creating a second disconnected Books architecture and required binding Prose into existing System Master architecture.
historical_instruction_recovered.implication: Prose was always intended to serve and integrate with a broader Books/Book System lifecycle rather than replace it.

lifecycle_classification.standing: Parent/child identity, next-step routing and fail-closed integration admission are now explicit.

evidence: Prose Craft Academy and research provenance
lifecycle_classification.standing: Substantial rights-governed craft intelligence exists; parent admission must remain explicit.

evidence: Prose project voice hierarchy and preservation contracts
canonical narrative state / passage-state / revision-preservation machinery
lifecycle_classification.standing: Strong Prose implementation exists but no parent-authoritative Book System lifecycle ownership contract was found in the audited surfaces.
Substantial implementation/qualification exists in Prose; not equivalent to parent workflow admission.
Evaluator capability is active under its own privacy/exact-SHA boundaries and has no parent canonical-write authority.
Representation/orchestration exists, but held-out extraction quality remains the dominant Prose empirical gap and parent ownership/admission is not yet defined.
No dedicated parent-authoritative lifecycle contract was found in the audited repository surfaces defining creation of a Book System book project, immutable book identity and initial governing brief.

Child-level canon/narrative machinery exists, but no parent contract was found defining Book System ownership, version authority, mutation rights, approval and rollback across the complete authoring lifecycle.

Prose has passage/scene/chapter diagnostics and global anchors, but no parent lifecycle contract was found governing plan -> chapter -> scene -> draft states and dependency progression for a complete book.

Real-book and revision artifacts exist in child qualification, but no audited parent contract defines canonical manuscript version, candidate versions, accepted/rejected revisions, durable artifact identity and restoration across the full Book System.

Research/provenance systems exist in Prose, but no parent lifecycle contract was found defining how research claims/evidence attach to book/chapter/scene state and how stale or conflicting evidence is resolved.
Child guardrails correctly prohibit automatic publication/overwrite; parent completion criteria, export/version freeze and explicit publication authorization remain to be defined.

what_was_missing_before_this_repair: A durable parent Book System lifecycle/control layer connecting book identity, canon/story-bible authority, planning/drafting progression, research/evidence, child Prose capabilities, evaluator capabilities, manuscript/artifact versions and completion/export.
recovery_conclusion: Do not rebuild Prose and do not collapse Book System into Prose. The next parent work should define the missing Book System authoring lifecycle contracts and interfaces, using the recovered child/lane capabilities as providers behind the parent integration boundary.
next_objective_requirements: Define immutable book/project identity and governing brief.
Define parent-owned canon/story-bible authority, versioning, mutation approval and rollback.
Define plan/chapter/scene/draft lifecycle states and dependency transitions.
Define research/evidence attachment and freshness/conflict rules.
Define Prose Project service interfaces without granting automatic canonical mutation.
Define Book Evaluator service interface and acceptance/evaluation boundary.
Define manuscript/candidate/revision artifact version authority and restoration.
Define author review/decision queues and abstention/defer behavior.
Define completion/export freeze and explicit publication boundary.
Bind each interface to parent integration proposal/admission states.
qualification_effect: NONE. This is a forensic recovery/classification record and creates no code, A-01, human, author, promotion or publication authority.
